description: This line plot illustrates the change in BPC (bits per character) over training steps for the SimSMoE model during validation. The x-axis represents Training Steps, scaled logarithmically from 0 to 50,000 (indicated as 50 × 10³), with tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis represents BPC, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot features a single magenta line with solid line style and star-shaped markers, labeled "SimSMoE Validating" in the legend. This line begins at a BPC value of approximately 2.2 at 0 training steps and exhibits a rapid decline, reaching a BPC of approximately 1.2 by 20,000 training steps. From 20,000 to 50,000 training steps, the BPC value stabilizes at approximately 1.2, showing minimal fluctuation. A shaded gray rectangle in the legend area indicates the region corresponding to the "SimSMoE Validating" line.
